name: Toudouin Reiko
source:
A rich girl with a closeted upbringing, who travels with a faithful butler everywhere she goes. She could buy any car she wanted, but for some reason her favorite is a familiar older model. She's rather clueless and airheaded about most things, but when behind the wheel she demonstrates fearless driving technique.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/moero2/]official English site[/url]]
